turns.question: What was our average basket size, in euros, in the week starting Monday 21 September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric called basket size; the closest is Average order value (EUR), the average amount of a non-cancelled order, which was 130.28 EUR for 21 to 27 September 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
